+1 to taking this on. Drafted a short playbook (attached) — the gist below.

----- playbook summary -----
Scope: evidence for BYO/KMS keys, SSO sessions, and audit logs when Novamed requests an on-call escalation.

1) Triage (On-call engineer) — confirm scope and urgency in the intake form; tag with severity.
2) Evidence collection (Ops runbook):
   - Audit logs: export JSON from audit-stream (command: redwood-audit export --tenant novamed --since <time> --format json) to s3://redwood-evidence/novamed/<id>.zip (retained 90 days by default).
   - KMS custody: produce key-hash manifest + last-rotation metadata; if CMK is customer-owned, include HSM attestation path.
   - SSO session artifacts: session IDs and token issuance logs (redacted PII) pulled from auth-stream.
3) Packaging & signing: evidence bundle signed by on-call engineer (PGP) and uploaded to the secure transfer bucket; a signed delivery note created if KMS custody proofs are partial.
4) Approvals:
   - <72 hours: standard evidence release — Product Manager approval (Marissa) + Security Ops sign-off (Soojin).
   - >72 hours or when KMS custody is involved: Legal + Sales Ops escalation.
5) Carveouts: allowed temporary retention windows: 24h, 7d, 30d (explicit approvals required; see escalation matrix).

I've attached 'byo_oncall_playbook_v1.md' and a small escalation_matrix.xlsx. Please review for accuracy — Marissa, flag any product constraints.

Soojin Lee
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — reviewed Soojin's draft. A couple of product constraints and clarifications before we send to Novamed: 

- Model binding: evidence for requests tied to Redwood Dedicated instances will include instance-id and pinned model version. For hosted model variants we can supply request traces but cannot release internal kernel telemetry. Need to call this out explicitly in the playbook.
- Evidence delivery SLA: agree to the 12-hour initial response for on-call escalations, but change the default delivery window to 48 hours for standard requests (we can expand to 72 where cross-team validation is required).
- Carveouts: product requires a signed order (SUP-4821) to enable >7d temporary retention for tenant data — Ben, please confirm procurement path and who signs.

Elaine — if that looks acceptable I'll file SUP-4821 and route a DocuSign amendment for the temporary retention clause. Proposed next steps:
